## High-impact signals

| Class | Patterns |
|---|---|
| `rights-change` | change rights, alter rights, update rights, transfer rights, assign rights, modify rights |
| `share-change` | change shares, alter shares, update shares, modify shares, rebalance shares |
| `percentage-change` | change percentage, update percentage, alter percentage, modify percentage, change split |
| `entity-merge` | merge participants, merge artists, merge duplicates, merge entities, definitive merge |
| `deletion` | delete, permanently remove, purge records, erase records |
| `destructive-data` | drop table, truncate, bulk delete, drop column |
| `signature` | sign contract, mark as signed, apply signature, countersign |
| `legal-action` | legal action, legal notice, terminate contract, lawsuit, takedown notice |
| `payment` | pay, payment, payout, transfer funds, wire |
| `external-send-irreversible` | send email, submit distribution, send to distributor, send to society |
| `external-publish-irreversible` | publish release, publish to stores, go live to stores, publish externally |
| `auto-fix-legal-financial` | auto fix, repair inconsistency, automatic repair, fix shares automatically |
